title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the block's speed at point C must be 6 m/s.

title: Heat Generated Q
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the heat generated must be 9 J.

title: Projectile Motion at B
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the horizontal launch velocity v0 to the tangential entry velocity vB at point B using the geometry (vB sinθ = v0).

title: Energy Conservation on Track
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem correctly between points B and C, accounting for the change in gravitational potential energy (mgR(1+sinθ)).

title: Relative Motion Analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the sliding phase using Newton's second law to find the accelerations of both the block and the board.

title: Common Velocity Condition
description: Important: The solution must establish that sliding stops when the block and board reach a common velocity, using kinematic equations or momentum conservation.

title: Energy Balance for Heat
description: Important: The solution must apply an energy balance (conservation of energy) for the sliding process to relate the initial kinetic energy to the final kinetic energy plus heat Q.

title: Sign or Geometry Error
description: Pitfall: A common error is misidentifying the height difference for potential energy (e.g., using cosθ instead of (1+sinθ)).

title: Friction Force Misapplication
description: Pitfall: A common error is incorrectly applying Newton's second law during sliding, such as using the wrong mass for acceleration or forgetting the board accelerates.
